samples.prompt: What is 7 * 8? Reply with only the number.
Explain in two sentences why four-bit model weights use less GPU memory than sixteen-bit weights.

message.content: Four-bit weights require only one-quarter of the storage space needed for sixteen-bit weights because they represent each parameter with 4 bits instead of 16. Consequently, this reduction in data size allows the model to occupy significantly less GPU memory, enabling larger models to run on hardware with limited resources.
